contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_fts_doc_chunks_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `doc_chunks` BEGIN DELETE FROM `fts_doc_chunks` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_fts_doc_chunks_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `doc_chunks` BEGIN DELETE FROM `fts_doc_chunks` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_fts_doc_chunks_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `doc_chunks` BEGIN INSERT INTO `fts_doc_chunks`(`docid`, `chunkText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`chunkText`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_fts_doc_chunks_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `doc_chunks` BEGIN INSERT INTO `fts_doc_chunks`(`docid`, `chunkText`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`chunkText`); END
